inputs.original_text: Introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties for...
inputs.modified_text: They’re dressing up a new design mandate for guns sold in New York as a way to prevent illegal machine-gun conversions, but that safety story looks like cover for expanding control over what people can buy. The reference to criminal penalties makes it more than advice: it signals enforcement. And the message cuts off before explaining what those penalties apply to—conveniently leaving the scope of the plan in the dark.
